CERT-In Vulnerability Note CIVN-2026-0508
Multiple Vulnerabilities in SonicWall SMA1000

Original Issue Date:October 19, 2026

Severity Rating: CRITICAL

Software Affected

  • SMA 1000 (6210, 7210, 8200v - all hypervisors)
  • Platform-hotfix version 12.4.3-03526 and earlier versions.
  • Platform-hotfix version 12.5.0-02952 and earlier versions.

Overview

Multiple vulnerabilities have been reported in SonicWall Secure Mobile Access (SMA) 1000 Series appliances, which could allow an attacker to direct the appliance to access internal functionality and perform unauthorized operations.

Target Audience:
All organizations and individuals using affected SonicWall SMA 1000 Series appliances.

Risk Assessment:
High to critical risk due to SSRF, remote code execution, path traversal, and stored cross-site scripting.
 
Impact Assessment:
Potential for unauthorized operations, arbitrary OS command execution, unauthorized file access, exposure of sensitive information.

Description

SonicWall is a cybersecurity company that provides network security and secure remote access solutions, including Secure Mobile Access (SMA) appliances.

These vulnerabilities exist in the SonicWall products due to improper neutralization of special elements used in an OS command.

Solution

Apply appropriate updates as mentioned as mentioned by the Vendor:
https://www.sonicwall.com/support/notices/kA1VN000002QP3G0AW

https://psirt.global.sonicwall.com/vuln-detail/SNWLID-2026-0017
